title: Cinnamon Roll Cookies
hookLine: Global-inspired cinnamon roll cookies with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: In a large bowl, combine the butter and caster sugar until creamy. Add the egg and a pinch of salt. 2) Stir into a buttery mixture. Add the sifted flour. 3) Whisk well. You should end up with a smooth dough. Cover it with a piece of plastic wrap and put the dough in the fridge for 15 minutes to chill and set. Incorporate {m53462_1}, {m53462_2}, {m53462_3}, and {m53462_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure plain flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: In the meantime combine the cassonade (or brown sugar) and the cinnamon. 5) Transfer the dough onto a floured surface and knead it for a minute. Add extra flour if necessary. Roll the dough out gently into a nice rectangle. It should be about ⅕-inch (5 mm) thick. Sprinkle with the sugary cinnamon mixture. 6) Carefully start rolling the dough up. If it is too sticky, put it in the fridge again for a couple of minutes. Wrap it up tightly in plastic wrap. Incorporate {m53462_5}, {m53462_6}, and {m53462_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Cinnamon Roll Cookies & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 18 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Put it in the fridge for 30 minutes to chill and set. After that, remove the cling film and cut the dough roll into even slices. 8) Place the slices on a baking paper lined baking tray. Bake the cookies in a preheated oven at 356°F (180°C) for 14 to 16 minutes. 9) Let the baked cinnamon roll cookies cool down fully before eating or wrapping them up.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
